business.name: Health insurance teaching slice
business.jurisdiction: Illustrative US context, not legal guidance

provenance.method: Conceptual synthesis; names, grains, attributes, relationships, and outputs re-authored.

domains.name: member
domains.description: Owns the member business records within the explicitly bounded teaching scope.

subdomains.name: person_identity
subdomains.description: Groups the member products by business responsibility.

products.name: identity
products.grain: One insured person, independent of a coverage episode.
products.description: Authoritative identity for the insured person in this teaching scope.

attributes.name: identity_id
attributes.description: Stable surrogate identifier for this record.

attributes.name: source_member_number
attributes.description: Source-system member identity for reconciliation.

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: Person's given name as recorded by the enrollment source.

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: Person's family name as recorded by the enrollment source.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Person's date of birth used in eligibility processing.

attributes.name: identity_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the insured identity.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the identity entered this system.

domains.name: plan
domains.description: Owns the plan business records within the explicitly bounded teaching scope.

subdomains.name: plan_design
subdomains.description: Groups the plan products by business responsibility.

products.name: health_plan
products.grain: One version of a offered health-plan design.
products.description: Versioned plan design used to define coverage commitments.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Stable surrogate identifier for this record.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Source plan code, unique together with the design version.

attributes.name: design_version
attributes.description: Version of the plan benefit design.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Business label of the offered health plan.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: First date on which this design is effective.

attributes.name: effective_to
attributes.description: Exclusive end date of this design, if retired.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency for plan monetary terms.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Individual deductible under this design.

domains.name: enrollment
domains.description: Owns the enrollment business records within the explicitly bounded teaching scope.

subdomains.name: coverage_management
subdomains.description: Groups the enrollment products by business responsibility.

products.name: coverage
products.description: Coverage episode binding a person to a versioned plan design.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Stable surrogate identifier for this record.

attributes.name: identity_id
attributes.description: Covered person owned by the member domain.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Plan design governing this coverage episode.

attributes.name: coverage_from
attributes.description: Inclusive start date of coverage.

attributes.name: coverage_to
attributes.description: Exclusive end date of coverage, if terminated.

attributes.name: coverage_status
attributes.description: Current state of the coverage episode.

attributes.name: elected_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the coverage election was accepted.

domains.name: provider
domains.description: Owns the provider business records within the explicitly bounded teaching scope.

subdomains.name: provider_identity
subdomains.description: Groups the provider products by business responsibility.

products.name: provider
products.description: Authoritative provider identity used in service and network records.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Stable surrogate identifier for this record.

attributes.name: provider_number
attributes.description: Source provider identity used for reconciliation.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Provider's business display label.

attributes.name: provider_kind
attributes.description: Provider identity category.

attributes.name: provider_status
attributes.description: Operational provider lifecycle state.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the provider record was created.

domains.name: network
domains.description: Owns the network business records within the explicitly bounded teaching scope.

subdomains.name: network_participation
subdomains.description: Groups the network products by business responsibility.

products.name: provider_network
products.grain: One provider network offered by the business.
products.description: Named service network used to organize provider participation.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Stable surrogate identifier for this record.

attributes.name: network_code
attributes.description: Business identifier of the provider network.

attributes.name: network_name
attributes.description: Business display label of the network.

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Operational lifecycle state of the network.

products.name: participation
products.description: Effective participation agreement between a provider and network.

attributes.name: participation_id
attributes.description: Stable surrogate identifier for this record.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Provider participating in the network.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Network accepting this provider.

attributes.name: participation_from
attributes.description: Inclusive first date of this participation agreement.

attributes.name: participation_to
attributes.description: Exclusive end date if participation ended.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Agreement lifecycle state.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when participation was recorded.

domains.name: claim
domains.description: Owns the claim business records within the explicitly bounded teaching scope.

subdomains.name: claim_processing
subdomains.description: Groups the claim products by business responsibility.

products.name: claim_status
products.description: Reference vocabulary for claim states, including more than six categories.

attributes.name: claim_status_id
attributes.description: Stable surrogate identifier for this record.

attributes.name: status_code
attributes.description: Stable machine-readable processing state.

attributes.name: status_label
attributes.description: Human-readable processing state label.

attributes.name: is_terminal
attributes.description: Whether this state ends normal processing.

products.name: header
products.grain: One submitted claim version for a coverage episode.
products.description: Claim submission identity and event-time financial totals.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Stable surrogate identifier for this record.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Coverage episode for the insured person at service time.

attributes.name: billing_provider_id
attributes.description: Provider submitting the bill.

attributes.name: rendering_provider_id
attributes.description: Provider that performed the service.

attributes.name: claim_status_id
attributes.description: Current processing state in the claim status vocabulary.

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Source claim identifier used for reconciliation.

attributes.name: submission_version
attributes.description: Source version of this submitted claim.

attributes.name: received_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this claim version was received.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Business service date attributed to the claim.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency for all claim amounts.

attributes.name: billed_amount
attributes.description: Event-time total billed on this submitted version.

attributes.name: allowed_amount
attributes.description: Allowed total for this claim version.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Paid total for this claim version.

products.name: line
products.grain: One service line within a submitted claim version.
products.description: Service detail retaining price at the time of service.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Stable surrogate identifier for this record.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Owning claim submission header.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Service line sequence within the owning header.

attributes.name: service_code
attributes.description: Source service identifier; no licensed code list is distributed.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Date when the line's service was performed.

attributes.name: service_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity billed for the service line.

attributes.name: unit_price_at_service
attributes.description: Price recorded at service time, not today's price.

products.name: adjudication
products.grain: One adjudication decision event on a claim version.
products.description: Auditable decision event; several decisions can exist for a claim.

attributes.name: adjudication_id
attributes.description: Stable surrogate identifier for this record.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Claim version receiving the adjudication event.

attributes.name: decided_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the decision was recorded.

attributes.name: decision_outcome
attributes.description: Decision result for this event.

attributes.name: decision_reason
attributes.description: Business rationale for the decision event.

attributes.name: allowed_amount_at_decision
attributes.description: Allowed amount at this decision event.

relationships.justification: The covered person relationship is required by the declared business grain.
The governing plan relationship is required by the declared business grain.
The participating provider relationship is required by the declared business grain.
The accepting network relationship is required by the declared business grain.
The service coverage relationship is required by the declared business grain.
The billing relationship is required by the declared business grain.

relationships.enrichment_path: Resolve the rendering provider during claim enrichment before completion.
relationships.justification: The rendering relationship is required by the declared business grain.
The processing state relationship is required by the declared business grain.
The owning submission relationship is required by the declared business grain.
The decided submission relationship is required by the declared business grain.

metric_views.name: claim_financials
metric_views.grain: Claim submission versions grouped by service month and currency; not unique business claims.
metric_views.description: Submitted-version financial totals without cross-source join fan-out.

requirements.description: Keep the six named domains and the ten teaching products.
Declare valid typed keys and required claim/coverage dependencies.
Provide glossary and declared personal-data classification.
Provide one single-source claim financial projection.
Review real business cardinality, snapshot ownership, and temporal semantics.
